verdict.rationale: Devin's docs say you can delegate a task in the web app and take over in Devin's IDE once it has a first draft. They also say you can jump in to help with browsing tasks through the Interactive Browser. Together these cover the core of taking over or redirecting in-progress work in the editor and browser. Missing for 10: evidence of taking control in Devin's terminal (the docs only mention watching commands and copying output), detail on how a takeover hands control back or redirects the task, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
